steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Know the WHOLE play, not just the extracts — context matters for every question. | Key Fact: Extract questions: analyse the specific scene AND connect it to the whole play's themes and structure. | Key Fact: Three perspectives: you may be asked from performer, director or designer viewpoint — always answer from the specified perspective. | Key Fact: Structure your answer: point (identify technique/choice) + evidence (specific reference) + explanation (effect on audience) + link (to whole play themes).

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: How would you approach a written exam question asking you to describe how you would perform an extract from your set text? | Why is it important to understand the whole play, even though the exam only asks about extracts? | Describe how you would answer a question from a director's perspective about staging a key scene.
